property_summary: For any call to initialize, the changeFee stored in the contract equals the _changeFee argument passed to initialize; the mutant sets changeFee to type(uint56).max instead of the argument, so the state variable differs for all inputs where _changeFee != type(uint56).max.
change_summary: Replace `changeFee = _changeFee;` with `changeFee = type(uint56).max;` to set the fee to the maximum possible.
